subject.name: Zoologists and wildlife biologists
subject.summary: Zoologists and wildlife biologists correspond to O*NET19-1023.00, studying animal taxonomy, behavior, genetics, disease, and life processes, surveying wild populations and habitats, analyzing environmental and human activity effects, and producing papers, reports, and conservation management recommendations. The research may take place in offices, laboratories, and the field, and is not daily husbandry, veterinary practice, or self-authorized enforcement. Degrees, positions, research activity permits, and on-site safety are verified separately; the paper exercise only compares fictional observation records and does not contact animals or infer real populations.
